CustomField.description: Auto Converts the difference between MQL Date Time and First Activity Date Time fields to days, hours, and minutes.
CustomField.formula: IF( First_Activity_Date_Time__c - MQL_Date_Time__c > 0 , TEXT( FLOOR( First_Activity_Date_Time__c - MQL_Date_Time__c ) ) & " days " & TEXT( FLOOR( MOD( (First_Activity_Date_Time__c - MQL_Date_Time__c ) * 24, 24 ) ) ) & " hours " & TEXT( ROUND( MOD( (First_Activity_Date_Time__c - MQL_Date_Time__c ) * 24 * 60, 60 ), 0 ) ) & " minutes", "" )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Auto Converts the difference between MQL Date Time and First Activity Date Time fields to days, hours, and minutes.
CustomField.label: First Activity Response Time
